name: Mceeju
description: Root one, the one of joy and light

name: Nmei
description: God of fate, left side of Mceeju

name: Lcaoc
description: God of wit, right side of Mceeju. Undisputed lord of the Outer Planes. Even though people does not pray to him, any being that has an order or a way of thinking and functioning give power to Lcaoc. Also mentioned as the God of civilization. He promotes united work towards a single work and sets in place laws to keep his followers undistracted from ever moving forward

name: Veri
description: Goddess of life, sister responsible from Iz. The most widespread worshipped deity. Her light heals the sick and grows the crops. She is a beacon of hope and freedom. Her servants spread charity and goodwill while hunting the undead. Her being responsible of the plane Iz, is the reason she is an overdeity

name: Uke
description: God of life. While mysterious, Uke is one of the oldest 3 gods. Has ties to many other worlds since life is a wonderful thing to pray about

name: Cyaxo
description: Snake god, creator of all land. Also known as Dcei, God of forests. God of tamed nature, crops, breeding animals and farming. Many people besides adventurers pray to him at night. Protects and watches nature in its purest form. Worshippers of Cyaxo see civilization in a disturbed way. Wood elves, rangers, fishermen and anyone else who get in the wild pray for Cyaxo's protection and guidance

name: Ehx
description: Dragon goddess, creator of all sky. Also known as Coz, Goddess of the sun and Ledr, Goddess of birds. Mother of metallic dragons and takes a human form to give wisdom

name: Buib
description: Goddess of rain. Rain gives life to crops and cleans hidden trails of who need it. Buib is also the patron goddess of Bards. Considering how bards are the media, no wonder she is a greater god

name: Radu
description: God of heroism, believed to be the lord of Overworld. Inspirations, youth, morning, vitality, self improvement are all Radu's points

name: Pwazo
description: Dark Goddess of flames, of tyrannical control, believed to be the lord of Underworld. Creatures inhabiting the Underworld usually pray to their ruler. Known for the ambition and cruel dispositions

name: Vihi
description: Goddess of love and affection, sister responsible from Iz. Vihi's church also specializes in beauty products, help people be more charming, teach how to seduce and more. Everyone wants to be charming, therefore the size of worshippers are massive

name: Naahv
description: God of death. The Unavoidable. Judges souls in the City of Judgement and sends them to a respective plane. If the soul is faithless, they get cast away at the wall of souls, that make up the walls of the City of Judgement

name: Boghradyn
description: Values wisdom and virtue as highly as gold. The allfather god of the Dwarves encourages the two simple desires of all Dwarves. A good heart beneath your forge and a family warmed by it. Also known as Moradin

name: Yr'snn
description: Creator of Elves and patron of all things in elf values. His creativity are granted to all artists including the arcane arts. He shares Boghradyn's hatred of orcs and holds a special thing for the drow. Also known as Corellon

name: Guulagh
description: Orc God. Not ambitious, and not quite admirable, Guulagh commands all his children to multiply, raid and take. Savage god of savage people, wages a war towards the destruction of all other species. Also known as Gruumsh

name: Zharathuun
description: Crazed god of madness. Seeks to undo all there is and ever will be. Also known as Tharizdun

name: Cfofb
description: God of storms. Barbaric god of power, both in nature and creatures. Well placed lightnings gives broad pleasure. Represents focused power and reckless fury

name: Vesvjdegz
description: God of lightning, also known as Ves and Biaf because of the roaring. He promotes freedom and dislikes safety. Luck alone guides his followers. He smiles upon those whom had a positive change on the world

name: Gud
description: God of war. Gud's sense of war only applies to ones that are orderly, with a win-lose condition and something to gain. His followers are not against war but does not promote it, because that benefits Fexyiaf and such war would cause Wodroh to rise up

name: Lwaqy
description: God of pain, darkness and suffering. Crying, broken god. Connected to Fey, he holds as many secrets as the night sky. The one who endures. Takes on the pain of people and tells his paladins to do the same. Anyone who suffers prays to him

name: Fexyiaf
description: Goddess of villains. Deception and destruction flow through Fexyiaf. Power to obliterate enemies. People that want something destroyed. Besides these people, there is Evocation

name: Modgo
description: God of curses. While most wouldn't pray to him, the ones seeking control and domination in a competitive environment usually follow his ways. This is why Modgo has churches and temples as an evil, intermediate god

name: Wiob
description: Hero of the moon, believed to oversee the Inner Planes. Shines light at night to all who need it. Browses stars for who seek it and navigates the ones that are lost. Wiob always answers to a call for help and will always respond. Picking him is not allowed

name: Wodroh
description: God of murder. Him and his followers are dedicated to one cause; unnatural ending of the mortal life. Truly evil deity who delights in simple pleasures. Torture and slavery. The crawling king of the underdark represents all the more menacing dark aspects of the underdark itself and the cruelty that has shaped its people

name: Tsahnrad
description: God of crafting. Many artisans, dwarves and gnomes believe in this deity. Also known as Gond

name: Wusor
description: God of magic, also known as Czeyz

name: Yrchenn
description: Goddess of sea. Even though she is evil, many pray to her out of fear. She punishes those whom do not give proper sacrifice. Sentient water creatures also pray to her, and are the cause that she is an intermediate deity. Also known as Umberlee

name: Atlatmak
description: Kobold deity. Kobolds are monotheistic and very, very crowded. Also known as Kurtulmak

name: Xua
description: Goddess of shadows, stealth and secrecy. Thieves and assassins pray to Xua. Responsible for a stain on the underdark known as the drow. Malicious and cruel, Xua favors female followers to men

name: Mykthyr
description: Goddess of rangers and trees. Also known as Mielikki. Mykthyr calls to rangers on a good dream

name: Pedi
description: Underworld demon, created by Pwazo to assist him

name: Raxcoh
description: Helper to the ones in need

name: Tezr
description: God of flowers

name: Maies
description: God of battles, also associated with violent takebacks of past promises

name: Yadseca
description: Goddess of smell

name: Nizi
description: Goddess of completion

name: Lunm
description: God of childbirth, also known as Msiys

name: Cyani
description: God poison, patron of nearly every assassin. His methods are methodical but results are definite. Worshippers are promised with great wealth and success, with great punishment upon failure. Among some of is most zealous priests are Yuan-Ti

name: Ayrugcumoak
description: Goddess of knowledge. Hates the ones hiding knowledge from the ones seeking it. She greatly favors research instead of practice. Those worship her work tirelessly to preserve information. She is referenced as 'The Eye', 'Eye of Knowledge' and in many other ways

name: Afez
description: God of belongings

name: Wugv
description: Goddess of numbers, also known as Xoypoh

name: Gaajyx
description: Wicked goddess of wealth. Greedy queen of hoarders. Her greed and lust for eternal wealth risk the world of an eternal unbalance

name: Gezi
description: Goddess of wine and food

name: Waqorafe
description: God of medicine

name: Megm
description: Goddess of architecture and cities, associated with building

name: Wadqwofm
description: God of merchants

name: Lwaro
description: Goddess of blades, believed to be shackled since the Black Rain

name: Gaxaca
description: God of strength, son of Wiob and Vihi

name: Catequil
description: Young man blessed with the power of thunder. Disappeared 3000 years ago and then resurfaced as shadowborn, Catequil is raised once more by mortals and is also known as Gregor Catequil

name: Spina
description: God of thorns, natural pain, fell from their throne as a lesser god

name: Jenelius Londste
description: Former demigoddess of devotion, usually associated with fanatic determination

name: Eve Archambeau
description: Former demigoddess of redemption, also associated with gemstones and jewelry. Commonly addressed as Ruby

name: Nepi
description: Formerly god of dice, also known as Vopx. Redirects his worshippers to his domain for balance, therefore a demigod

name: Astro
description: Mage of corruption, also associated with mosquitoes. Oddly specific, people who want corruption are less than those who hate mosquitoes. Astro being an evil demigod gains from this

name: Oxar Ares
description: Demigod of chaos, associated with wounds. His followers usually lack determination and the required attention span and they are overall chaotic to get things done for Oxar Ares and end up working for another deity

name: Czeis
description: Demigod of speed, also associated with news and respect. Unfortunately since Buib exists, many decide to believe in her

name: Lara Navye
description: Demigoddess of rabbits, also associated with love and children

name: Xenia
description: Demigoddess of hallucinogens

name: Sai
description: Demigod of runes and traps

name: Anomenada
description: Demigoddess of alchemy

name: Czeeg
description: Once the god of spears also associated with war, now a demigod. Picking him is not allowed
